scope: Prepared Ed25519 public and secret key APIs, narrow vendored math hooks, compiler binding and portable reference, against frozen prepared-type SDK24d8d0b9.

validation.actual_gc: Both prepared key types in arrays/records/coreMap survived13awaits and proved >4MiB reclaimed; continued signing/verification passed.

source_review: Prepared public payload is canonicalA32 plus32canonical field encodings for8odd multiples of -A; no native pointers, Rust layouts, mutable global cache or incomplete bytes. Canary/guard tests verify complete initialization and field/scalar bounds.

Prepared verification preserves canonical/on-curve/non-small-order R and S<L guards. It hashes original R/A/message, multiplies positive reduced k by cached -A, and compares exact compressed R, preserving mixed-order strict semantics.
Prepared secret scalar,prefix and compressedpublicA come from one validatedseed. Secret restoration does not reclamp; prepared signing retains original fixed-base and constant-time scalar arithmetic.

Codegen unwraps nominal keys, allocates managed results before borrowing pointers, and has no callback/GC while runtime borrows input. Protected types reject Blob forging, public-secret interchange, raw extraction, stable/shared/Candid/debug boundaries.
Managed prepared secret bytes persist until collection and are not zeroized on GC; this is explicitly documented. No raw prepared-key import is exposed.
harness_corrections: Initial run passed all runtime checks; two forged-literal fixtures were strengthened to explicit Blob, and debug_show diagnostic matcher corrected for promoted Any. Initial evidence retained in initial/.
integration_followup: Actual cross-plugin prepared-type substitutions are assigned to prepared_integration once all plugin artifacts coexist.
